text.description_html:
Acorn AZC209, Integrity Cabinet Contemporary Knob:

Uniquely shaped, this Acorn Stainless steel cabinet knob is an excellent way to add a modern design aesthetic to your home without leaning towards the sterility that some contemporary decor has. In fact, there is nothing boring about this cabinet pull. Crafted out of stainless steel, it straddles the barrier between art and functionality wonderfully. It is the perfect way to add points of interest to your home while proving form and function can be one and the same. Comes in a brushed stainless steel finish.

Also Available: Integrity Stainless Steel Knob

Specifications for the Acorn AZC209 Absolute Zero Collection Integrity Cabinet Knob:

  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Length: 1-7/8"
  • Projection: 1-1/8"
  • Width 1-1/4"
  • Available in polished stainless steel or brushed stainless steel.

Sold Individually



** This item is being discontinued by Acorn. Very limited quantities available.
